items.title: File Widerspruch against partial refusal
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Hansestadt Beispielwismar, Am Markt 1, 23966 Beispielwismar.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by an authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Mon 23.11.2026 (letter itself quotes this 4-day rule). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted; the one-month period (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB) runs from 24.11.2026 and ends on the same-numbered day one month later: Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a normal business day in MV (no shift needed).

warnings: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern has a transitional rule (§ 120a VwVfG M-V): if this matter (the original planning application or hearing) began before 1 January 2025, the old 3-day deemed-delivery rule could apply instead of the 4-day rule the letter cites, which would move the Widerspruch deadline a day earlier to 22.12.2026 — to be safe, submit well before 23.12.2026.
The letter refers to an earlier letter dated 23.10.2026 (Zeichen TK-8816-239) which is not attached; its content may be relevant to the full picture of this decision.

A subsidy ('Zuschuss') for the wood windows is only available on separate application ('auf Antrag') and has no date in this letter; it is not treated as a deadline here but the person should ask the authority how and by when to apply if they want it.
